sheets.title: ENLARGED FIRST FLOOR PLAN — DEMOLITION
sheets.reading_notes: Demolition floor plan for Suite 117, first floor of Building 3400. Shows existing room layout prior to renovation: Exam 117D, JAG/Soiled Linen 117E, Stor 117F/117G, Men's Toilet 117G, Women's Toilet 117H, OIC 117T, Lab 117J, Medical/Waiting 117Q, Immunization 117K, Files/Records 117S, Record Review 117O, Optometry 117N, Audiology 117L, Admin 117R, Exam2 117N, Exam3 117M. Scale 5/8"=1'-0". 12 demolition keynotes listed (remove ceilings, furniture, flooring, restroom fixtures/accessories/partitions/plumbing, mop sink, casework, wall-mounted sinks, signage, soffits). Title block reads 'CONSTRUCT OFFICES BLDG 3400 PAO/TDS, FORT GREGG-ADAMS, VIRGINIA'. Sheet 1 of 2. The existing suite appears to have been a medical/clinic use (exam rooms, optometry, audiology, immunization rooms) — a significant program-type change is occurring from clinic to administrative offices.

sheets.title: ENLARGED FIRST FLOOR PLAN — ARCHITECTURAL NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: New work floor plan showing proposed layout for reconfigured Suite 117. New rooms: Intake/Waiting Room 117T, Break Room (×2), Record/File Room 117T, Dressing Rooms 117H, Photo Lab 117J, Conference Room 117B, Record/Studio 117C, Storage/Files 117D, Reception/Open Office 117T, Copy Area, Cubicle/Open Office 117Q (×2 areas), Office 117K, Office 117L, Paralegal Office 117T, Attorney Office 117Q, Attorney Office 117S, Office 117R, Director's Office 117M. New walls shown hatched/heavy black; existing walls shown thin. Scale 5/8"=1'-0". Key room dimensions shown (13'-11", 13'-10", 17'-2", 13'-8", 13'-6", 10', 19'-4", etc.) but no explicit total area annotation. 8 new-work plan notes: (1) new 5/8" GWB + 3-5/8" metal stud walls with sound batt insulation; (2) new Roppe 700 series wall base; (3) new 3'-0" x 7'-0" wood doors; (4) new 24 oz 2x2 carpet tiles; (5) Sherwin Williams SW6119 Antique White paint; (6) patch/paint existing walls; (7) extend walls floor to below slab (offices, conference room, studio); (8) new 6'-0" x 7'-0" cased opening. Program is administrative/legal offices including PAO (Public Affairs Office) and TDS (Trial Defense Services). A photo lab and dressing rooms are notable specialty spaces. Legend shows new carpet tile and new vs. existing walls.
